No signature requests waiting for you. When a student asks you to sign a line in their logbook, it appears here.

How it works. Students ask from their logbook with Request instructor signature and pick you; the line lands here, oldest first. Your stamp (name, number, wording and signature) shows on their line as soon as you sign. Declining tells them why.
